message.content:
An editorial illustration features a large human figure in a blue-purple suit, seen from behind, standing on a low brown platform. This figure has their right hand on their hip and their left hand scratching their head. Before them is an ensemble of twelve smaller figures in light grey suits and bowties, positioned like an orchestra. 

These musicians hold various instruments: three large brass tubas, one saxophone, and one double bass. Most musicians look toward the central conductor figure with varied expressions; some have open mouths, while others gesture with open palms or point. Several musicians stand behind dark rectangular music stands.

The background is a dark, warm brown. Above the figures, the word “TEMPO” is partially visible in large, grey, outlined letters. The top of the image has a red rectangular block.

Text on the cover includes:
- “Beban Ekonomi Sertifikasi Halal H.84”
- “Jejak Bobby Nasution di Blok Medan H.72”
- “RIBET KABINET MUMET”
- A paragraph starting with “Kabinet besar Prabowo Subianto...” ending with “H.26”
- Date and pricing details: “28 OKTOBER-3 NOVEMBER 2024”, “RP 50.000”
- A barcode and QR code are in the bottom right corner.
